items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Marvin Stamm lives two minutes from me and I never see him.

ctx.x: Okay. And you might have like a singer there, if it was going to be sung.

Right. You’d hire a singer to come in, one of the studio singers would come in and do the demo, just maybe piano and voice that’s all. In those days you could do just a piano and voice demo. You didn’t have to do anything like elaborately produced as a demo. But the other good thing about it is that I got into scoring to film, post-scoring, which is a lot of fun. And I never really followed it up. I would love to have at some point in my life gotten into writing for movies. I did a lot of stuff for commercials. I…
Was there a club called Bradley’s recently that just shut down?
